## Your Rights as a Hospital Patient
F3.note: 'hospital patient' for 'hospital inpatient', a status that matters for Medicare

spans: **Medicare helps pay for your care.**
This includes hospital care that you need for your health.
You have the right to know what Medicare covers.
The hospital will work with you to make sure it is safe for you to leave. They can also help set up any care you may need after you go home.
If you are worried about anything, talk to your doctor or the hospital staff.
If you are not happy with the quality of your care, call this group: Midsouth Quality Review at 1-888-555-0142.
